en.title: 3-D Secure 2.0 Traveller Verification
en.prompt: Your issuing bank requires identity verification for security compliance.
en.instructions: Enter the 6-digit one-time security code sent to your registered mobile phone (+64 ***-**18).
en.successMsg: Authentication Approved. Redirecting to payment confirmation...
en.declineMsg: Authentication Unsuccessful. Card issuer rejected the verification code.
en.timeoutMsg: Session Timed Out. Authentication window exceeded 5 minutes.
en.unavailableMsg: Directory Server Unavailable. Issuer Access Control Server (ACS) unreachable.

zh.title: 3-D Secure 2.0 旅客身份安全验证
zh.prompt: 根据新西兰移民局与发卡银行安全合规要求，请完成本次身份验证。
zh.instructions: 请输入发送至您预留手机号（+64 ***-**18）的6位动态验证码。
zh.cancelBtn: 取消并返回 NZeTA 申请
zh.successMsg: 身份验证成功。正在跳转至支付确认页面...
zh.declineMsg: 身份验证未通过。发卡银行已拒绝本次验证请求。
zh.timeoutMsg: 会话超时。验证窗口已超过5分钟限制。
zh.unavailableMsg: 验证目录服务器暂时不可用。发卡行访问控制服务器（ACS）无响应。
